claim: Spatially correlated propagation residuals, beyond distance and device identity, can improve unseen-position localization
evidence_before: Single and dual slope dB objectives are worse; device offset gain below gate. Distance-only model is likely insufficient for walls.
mechanism: Known Gaussian-kernel smoothing of calibration-only receiver residuals added to path-loss field; bandwidth4m; Huber dB solver
failure_mode: Spatial leakage if test points entered field; extrapolation and sparse receiver coverage; audit training positions explicitly
novelty: Project integration experiment, not a new kernel regression theorem
